messages.content: Reading the brief: an entry program (main.ts / Node 22) that writes one line to /output/entry.txt - a one-line joke about working beside an AI coding agent. Constraints: UTF-8, 1-280 code points, non-whitespace, no network, sandbox. Delivered with public repo + commit and the agent session transcript. Selected the strong candidate joke: 'Working beside an AI coding agent: it writes the feature, breaks production at 4pm, and calmly suggests "maybe it's the cache".'

Created public repo masdju4/the-joke-about-the-demo-20261121-0551 with main.ts (writes entry.txt to /output, Node 22, no network), README.md and MIT LICENSE. Pushed commit 571949f20d81088849db267a5de862119289ebd4.

Smoke test: node main.ts; /output/entry.txt contains the chosen joke (127 Unicode code points, non-whitespace). Submission prepared: makefun CLI submit with --competition the-joke-about-the-demo-20261121-0551, repo URL, commit, transcript of this session, title 'The Joke About The Demo (masdju4)'.
